QuestInfo.name: Please Find My Little Brother
QuestInfo.1: #p2152008#'s brother #p2153003# has gone missing. He went to rescue #p2154004#, but went toward the #bMine#k where the adults warned them to stay away. #p2152008# is extremely worried. Find #b#p2153003##k for #p2152008#.
QuestInfo.2: #p2153003# refused to return home until he finds #p2154004#. He looks like a healthy little boy and can probably take care of himself just fine.

0.0: Sigh... Where could #p2153003# have gone? Um, have you seen a boy named #p2153003# around? He's my brother and he's been missing for a few days now. He left this strange note behind. Take a look.
0.1:
<Dear #p2152008#, 
I won't return until I rescue #p2154004# so don't look for me! 
               
                            From the super cool, #p2153003# >
0.2: What is he talking about? Rescue #p2154004#... The adults said that #p2154004# went on a trip. If you happen to see #p2153003#, can you please tell him to come home?

yes.0: #b#p2153003##k probably went towards the #bMine#k... If #p2154004# didn't really go on a trip, she's probably there, since that's THEIR headquarters... I mean... Nevermind. In any case, there are a lot of monsters on the way to the Mine, so be careful.

1.0: Why are you bothering me? Do you need something? If so, talk quickly. I'm very busy. Huh? #p2152008# sent you?

yes.0: Heh, that coward #p2152008# ! He didn't want to come with me, so why does he care where I went? I'm not returning until I rescue #p2154004#, so you can stop trying to convince to go home!

npc.0: Have you not found #p2153003# yet? He should be somewhere around the #bMine#k. He probably hasn't made it into the Mine yet, but he should be somewhere nearby.
